{
  "gate_id": "MB-GATE-EXPORT-001",
  "version": "1.0",
  "purpose": "Deterministic, fail-closed OS export",
  "export_rules": {
    "include": [
      "CANONICAL_SNAPSHOT/canonical_os.zip",
      "surface_contract.json",
      "mandatory_pipeline.json",
      "zoop.sh",
      "zoop.ps1",
      "README.md",
      "MANIFEST.json"
    ],
    "exclude": [
      "WORKING_OS/**",
      "SCRATCH/**"
    ]
  },
  "invariants": [
    "canonical_export_is_single_copy",
    "working_os_never_exported",
    "scratch_never_exported",
    "export_requires_manifest_and_hashes",
    "export_fails_if_rules_violated"
  ],
  "sandbox_constraints": {
    "max_recommended_size_mb": 150,
    "note": "If canonical exceeds UI limit, export still valid but UI may not surface download."
  }
}
